name: Ferrogate Emergency Response Vehicle
description: A fast, armored emergency vehicle that combines ambulance, fire response, and security functions. In a city where separate emergency services are a luxury, the ERV does everything badly — it can treat one patient, carry limited fire suppression, and mount a token security response. But it shows up. In Tier 1-2 districts where no one else comes, the red-and-white ERV is the only sign that someone, somewhere, acknowledges you exist. The crews are burned out, underfunded, and still showing up every shift.
propulsion: Electric, all-wheel drive, emergency speed governor
tier_availability: All districts (response time varies dramatically by tier)
armament: Sirens, lights, basic security equipment. Crew carries personal defense.
common_usage: Emergency medical response, fire suppression, security incidents, proving someone cares.
story_hooks: An ERV crew responds to a call in the deep Underworld and finds a community of thousands that isn't on any census
The ERV dispatch AI routes a crew to an emergency that hasn't happened yet — and when they arrive, it does
